image_description: A Dungeness crab positioned centrally on a bed of smooth, rounded river stones. The crab displays a broad, oval carapace with mottled brown and grey coloration that camouflages against the rocks. Its two large chelipeds (claws) are visible in the foreground, showing pale tips and robust structure. Several walking legs extend laterally, partially obscured by the body angle and surrounding stones.
